ceo_letter.author: Chi Ho Li
ceo_letter.title: CEO
promises: 2025 will be a year of sustainable, profitable growth
Focus on creating outstanding digital experiences for partners and players
Pushing boundaries of what platforms can achieve
Building long-lasting and sustainable shareholder value
honesty_signals: Specific numerical performance metrics provided (219% revenue growth, 71% operating loss reduction, SEK 7,843k positive net cash from operations)
Acknowledges rebranding transformation (not hiding organizational change)
Mentions post-period acquisition of Confetti Group with specific details
Notes expansion of talent pool with specific appointments
key_quotes: 2024 marked a historic full year of growth for EMB Mission Bound through our constant progress and transformation
We delivered a 219% increase in revenue compared to 2023, driven by the expansion of our royalty streams and service fees
Net cash flow from operations turned positive for the first time, reaching SEK 7,843k, a major milestone that underscores our strengthened operational efficiency
With a stronger product portfolio, an energized and capable team, and a proven strategy, we are confident that 2025 will be a year of sustainable, profitable growth

key_narratives: Global online gambling market expansion (USD 103bn to USD 169.22bn by 2030 at 10.44% CAGR)
EMB Mission Bound positioned to capitalize on market growth through fully integrated model
Rapid game production strategy addresses short game life cycles
Expansion into Asia-Pacific and European markets aligns with industry growth
Platform reliability and innovation drive competitive advantage
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management frames 2024 as a transformational year with historic achievements, emphasizing the 219% revenue growth as validation of strategy. The positive net cash from operations is presented as a major milestone confirming the company is on the right track toward profitability. Market expansion, product innovation, and platform enhancement are highlighted as key drivers of future growth.

segment_commentary.Premium Slot Games: Approximately twenty titles in portfolio. Revenue generated through royalties from distribution and technology access fees. High production pace maintained due to short game lifespan in market. Lady Luck Games business unit recently expanded leadership team with Russell Wan as CEO and Alvis Tran as COO to focus on scaling production, innovation, and diversifying game portfolio.

operational_highlights: Launched new EMB Remote Gaming Server (RGS) platform in February 2025 (post-period)
Acquired Confetti Group strategic assets and business for SEK 3.81m in March 2025 (post-period)
Appointed Richard Hau as Chief Operating Officer (January 2025)
Maintained licenses from UK Gambling Commission and Malta Gaming Authority
Board of Directors consists of 3 members
Generated SEK 13,734k service fees from CYG associate (FY23: SEK 1,456k)
concerns_mentioned: Competitive market with competitors having greater financial and marketing resources
Product development costs could exceed expectations due to growing digital game demand
Dependence on continuously meeting customer demand and product innovation
System failures, IT security vulnerabilities, data breaches, and computer viruses
Intellectual property risk of competitors developing similar products
License maintenance and obtaining new licenses in regulated and newly regulated markets

risks.risk: System failures and IT security breaches

guidance.commentary: No specific financial guidance provided. Board of Directors states that working capital and liquidity will be sufficient to continue operations as a going concern. Proposes no dividend be paid and result be carried forward. Several IASB amendments endorsed by EU have not yet been adopted but are not expected to significantly impact group's consolidated results.

segments.name: Premium Slot Games
segments.focus: High production pace to maintain innovation; expanded leadership team to scale production and diversify portfolio

executive_summary: EMB Mission Bound AB reported a transformational FY 2024 with revenue surging 219% year-over-year to SEK 27,828k, while achieving a 71% reduction in operating losses and the company's first positive net cash from operations of SEK 7,843k. The gaming technology company rebranded multiple times, underwent leadership transitions with Calvin Lim moving to Executive Chairman and Michael Li Chi Ho becoming CEO, and executed strategic moves including the Confetti Group acquisition and new EMB RGS platform launch in Q1 2025.
key_highlights: Operating loss reduced 71% to SEK 27,907k (2023: SEK 97,567k)
Total loss reduced 66% to SEK 24,459k (2023: SEK 72,016k)
Net cash flow from operations turned positive: SEK 7,843k (first time)
Acquired Confetti Group for SEK 3.81m in March 2025
Launched new EMB RGS platform in February 2025
Leadership transition: Calvin Lim to Executive Chairman, Michael Li Chi Ho to CEO, Richard Hau appointed COO
